crusadecraft.urban.param.style.hint: The pack buildings and walls come from. It must be installed.
crusadecraft.urban.param.habitants.hint: How many people: this decides almost everything else.
crusadecraft.urban.param.par_maison.hint: Fewer people per house means more houses, so a wider town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.richesse.hint: Building levels, and the share of fine and poor quarters.
crusadecraft.urban.param.niveau_min.hint: No building below this, even in poor quarters.
crusadecraft.urban.param.niveau_max.hint: No building above this, even in fine quarters.
crusadecraft.urban.param.modele.hint: Sets the street shape at once. Changing a layout setting makes it Custom.
crusadecraft.urban.param.reseau.hint: Branching: streets leave main roads at right angles. Rings: they circle the centre. Grid: straight.
crusadecraft.urban.param.routes.hint: How many main roads leave the centre. They go through the gates.
crusadecraft.urban.param.angle.hint: At 0 streets are straight; higher, they wind. Buildings stay at right angles.
crusadecraft.urban.param.segment.hint: A street changes direction at each segment. Short: it turns often.
crusadecraft.urban.param.branche.hint: How often a street spawns others. Larger means larger blocks.
The chance a street is as important as a main road, and that suburbs get side lanes.
crusadecraft.urban.param.ilot_min.hint: Below this, no house: it becomes a garden or a nook.
crusadecraft.urban.param.ilot_max.hint: Above this, an alley cuts it in two until each house can be reached.
In blocks. An alley is what cuts a lot that is too large.
crusadecraft.urban.param.rue_remparts.hi: A road that runs all around inside the walls.
crusadecraft.urban.param.placement.hint: Terraced: wall to wall, very dense. Detached: each on its own plot.
crusadecraft.urban.param.marge_rue.hint: How many blocks between the street and the façade.
crusadecraft.urban.param.remplissage.hin: Of 100 spots along a street, how many get a building.
crusadecraft.urban.param.matiere_rues.hi: As the civilisation: the mix typical of its style.
crusadecraft.urban.param.arbres_rues.hin: Mostly in fine quarters and parks.
crusadecraft.urban.param.place.hint: A large square in the middle, where the roads start.
crusadecraft.urban.param.centre.hint: The market leaves the square free for stalls; the others stand on it.
crusadecraft.urban.param.temple.hint: Build a temple or a cathedral.
crusadecraft.urban.param.espaces_verts.h: Parks and gardens in the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.bidonville.hint: Outside the walls, shacks packed along the roads.
crusadecraft.urban.param.q_marche.hint: Its share of the town: the higher, the more of it.
crusadecraft.urban.param.q_nobles.hint: Fine mansions, rather away from the walls.
crusadecraft.urban.param.q_marchands.hin: Shops and warehouses along the main roads.
crusadecraft.urban.param.q_artisans.hint: Workshops, towards the gates and the water.
crusadecraft.urban.param.q_admin.hint: The town hall and its neighbours, near the centre.
crusadecraft.urban.param.q_militaire.hin: Barracks and towers, against the walls.
crusadecraft.urban.param.q_pauvres.hint: Lowest-level houses, tightly packed, towards the walls.
crusadecraft.urban.param.type_mur.hint: Pack pieces look best, but only make a rectangle.
crusadecraft.urban.param.forme_mur.hint: No effect with pack pieces: they only fit at right angles.
crusadecraft.urban.param.hauteur_mur.hin: In blocks. Towers rise three more.
crusadecraft.urban.param.douves.hint: A water-filled ditch around the walls.
crusadecraft.urban.param.citadelle.hint: A closed fortress, with its own walls.
crusadecraft.urban.param.chateau_en_vill: Otherwise it backs on to the walls.
crusadecraft.urban.param.faubourgs.hint: The share of houses built outside the walls, along the roads.
crusadecraft.urban.param.densite_faubour: Of 100 spots along a road, how many get a building.
crusadecraft.urban.param.riviere.hint: A river crosses the town. Main roads bridge it.
crusadecraft.urban.param.ponts.hint: Auto: one per main road crossing it.
crusadecraft.urban.param.cote.hint: The sea on one side, or all around.
crusadecraft.urban.param.part_mer.hint: How much of the map it takes.
crusadecraft.urban.param.creuser.hint: River, sea and moat are dug into the ground. Otherwise the plan leaves them empty: place the town by your real water.
crusadecraft.urban.param.champs.hint: Where to farm. Lone farmsteads: farms and their fields, set apart.
crusadecraft.urban.param.climat.hint: Tree species. As the civilisation: acacias in Egypt, spruces in the North.
crusadecraft.urban.param.routes_campagne: How far main roads continue, in blocks.
crusadecraft.urban.param.cimetiere.hint: A graveyard in town, if there are enough people.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_house.hint: Auto: from the number of inhabitants.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_tavern.hint: Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_farm.hint: Auto: from the size of the town. Placed in the countryside.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_market.hint: Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_warehouse.hin: Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_church.hint: Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_graveyard.hin: Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_barracks.hint: Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_tower.hint: Auto: from the size of the town. Wall towers are set separately.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_craft.hint: Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_hospital.hint: Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_school.hint: Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_stall.hint: On the square. Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_statue.hint: On the square. Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_garden.hint: Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.param.b_decor.hint: Wells, carts… Auto: from the size of the town.
crusadecraft.urban.title: The town workshop
crusadecraft.urban.name: Town name
crusadecraft.urban.take.hint: The plan goes to the architect's plan in your hand: the ghost shows it, a click places it.
crusadecraft.urban.edits_forgotten: The layout changed: your edits on this plan are forgotten
crusadecraft.urban.no_pack: No pack of this civilisation is installed: pick another in the General tab.
crusadecraft.urban.stats: %s people · %s houses · %s others · %s lots · %s gates · %s towers · %s blocks
crusadecraft.urban.no_room: No room: %s. Less spacing, or more land
crusadecraft.urban.help: Wheel: zoom · Drag: move · Click: edit what you point at
crusadecraft.urban.building.help: Click: another model · Right click: remove it
crusadecraft.urban.save.name: Name of these settings
crusadecraft.urban.saved.failed: The file could not be written
